problem.headline: A challenge every parent recognizes
problem.body: Digital screens are designed to capture attention continuously. It's not the parent's fault, nor the child's. But physical objects that require tactile manipulation can restore deep, sustained focus and spatial curiosity.

pillars.title: No auto-advance feedback loops
pillars.body: Physical objects don't infinite-scroll or reward instant gratification. Children learn at their own natural pace.

pillars.title: Hands build attention
pillars.body: Manipulating objects with physical resistance builds fine motor skills and sustained, sequential focus.

pillars.title: Real difficulty curves
pillars.body: A physical puzzle can't be solved by mashing buttons. It teaches true problem solving and patience.

items.name: Wooden Logic Puzzles

items.name: Building Block Sets

items.name: Mechanical Construction Toys
items.description: Simple mechanical assemblies that introduce cause-and-effect reasoning.

items.q: Are these toys safe for children?
items.a: Yes! All products will be crafted from natural, non-toxic wood with smooth rounded edges and child-safe finishes.

items.q: What age group are these toys designed for?
items.a: Our initial Phase 1 lineup focuses on cognitive development for children aged 3 to 9 years.
Wood provides rich tactile feedback, durability, and a calm, sensory-friendly play experience free from artificial noise.
